newsitem.title: USA: BRE offer price set at $24.50 a share.
newsitem.headline: BRE offer price set at $24.50 a share.

text.p: BRE Properties Inc on Friday said a public offer of 4.0 million common shares has been priced at $24.50 per share.
Of the shares being offered, 3.35 million are being sold by BRE and 650,000 shares by a non-management shareholder.

BRE has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 600,000 additional shares. The offering was lead managed by Morgan Stanley & Co Inc. Co-managers included Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co and Prudential Securities Inc.
BRE, a real estate investment trust, intends to use net proceeds to repay debt under its revolving credit lines.
